TechnicalRecordIdentification.name: Technical Record Identification
TechnicalRecordIdentification.definition: Unique identifier of a record in a message used as part of error management and feedback messages.||Usage:|This identification will be used in the status advice report sent back.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identifies the financial instrument using an ISIN.

TotalTradingVolume.name: Total Trading Volume
TotalTradingVolume.definition: Total traded volume of the instrument in this specific reporting period.

TotalReferencePriceTradingVolume.name: Total Reference Price Trading Volume
TotalReferencePriceTradingVolume.definition: Total volume of trading under reference price waiver as defined under the local regulation.

TotalNegotiatedTransactionsTradingVolume.name: Total Negotiated Transactions Trading Volume
TotalNegotiatedTransactionsTradingVolume.definition: Total volume of trading under negotiated transactions waiver as defined under the local regulation.

ValidISINRule.definition: ISIN code must pass checksum validation.
